name: slider
title: Slider
description: HBD slider: single-handle or two-handle range, sm/md/lg sizes, optional value readout, tick marks, and hint/error footer. Re-based on @radix-ui/react-slider with the legacy .hbd-slider* classes re-applied to Track/Range/Thumb; controlled value (number | [low, high]) + onValueChange, plus onValueCommit. Full Arrow/Home/End/PageUp/PageDown keyboard support and per-thumb accessible names with aria-invalid/aria-describedby error wiring.
